text: In Agda, the 'Set' hierarchy Set₀, Set₁, Set₂, … corresponds to:
choices: the universe hierarchy U₀ : U₁ : U₂ : … in dependent type theory
explanation: Agda's Set_n corresponds to the n-th universe. Set₀ contains ordinary types; Set₁ contains Set₀; etc. This prevents universe paradox while allowing 'Type of types'.
